news_risk: No adverse regulatory action, penalty or negative media coverage found in the sources reachable during this check. Searches on Indian Kanoon for the company name returned only commercial, tax, patent and labour litigation (listed above), with no criminal proceedings, no regulator (SEBI/RBI/ED/SFIO/DGFT) action and no fraud or default reporting. Note: the DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) and Bing returned only generic, query-irrelevant results, so general news coverage could not be systematically swept — absence of negative news is therefore a limitation of this check, not a positive finding. Company website (steerworld.com) presents itself as a 1993-founded Bengaluru twin-screw extruder manufacturer (founder Dr. Babu Padmanabhan) with no mention of any controversy.
note: Sanctions: no match found for STEER ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN U72100KA1993PTC015303, Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru) on OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK or BIS Entity List in the sources reachable — but the sanctions-list lookups could not be executed directly (search backend refused connections; Bing ignored the query terms), so this is 'not found', not a verified clean screen. Recommend a direct re-screen against OFAC/EU/UK consolidated lists before onboarding. Court cases: 9 matters identified on Indian Kanoon, all civil/commercial/tax/patent/labour in nature — the company appears predominantly as plaintiff/appellant/petitioner (IP enforcement against GlaxoSmithKline, RKP Drives, UVW Extruder; GST and central excise writs; a patent appeal; one labour dispute at its Coimbatore plant). No criminal case against the company or its directors was found. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite rating for this entity was found in the accessible sources; not public or not rated, so no figure is asserted. Russia/CIS supply evidence: null — no customs, B-L, tender or media record of supplies to Russia or CIS states was found; the only Russia-adjacent hit was an unrelated ITAT Bangalore ruling involving group affiliate Steer America Inc. (US) on transfer pricing, which says nothing about Russian trade. This is 'no evidence found', not a confirmed negative.
